system.notes:
Strice Foods' deliberately low-cost corporate system (QE p.34), modelled as one SR2E host at Orange-4. The SR1 map's per-node codes are MANUAL:

  • SAN (gateway, #2206 / 312-1752) — Red-5, Access 5: a tougher Logon than the host baseline.
  • SPU-1 — Orange-3: Trace-and-Dump 3.
  • CPU — Orange-4: Barrier 3 + Tar Pit 4.
  • DS-1 — Orange-3, Barrier 4: purchase orders — the MegaMedia deal (1,280,000¥ for Euphoria's three appearances) and Knight Errant expenditures. 4 files × 70 Mp = 28,000¥ fenced.
  • DS-2 — Orange-5, Scramble 3: Accounts Receivable. 3 files × 80 Mp = 60,000¥.
  • DS-3 — Green-3: Seattle retailer/distributor list. 2 files × 40 Mp = 4,000¥.

Trigger: an external alert shuts the system down within two minutes. Any Trace result prints at Vincent Burroughs' terminal and he calls Lone Star — immediately if he is in-office by day, otherwise next morning. No vital clue lives here; the run is for paydata and the MegaMedia/Craft trail.
